chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever has one salat (prayer) accepted by Allah will not be punished, and whoever has one good deed accepted by Allah will not be punished."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.صَلَاةً: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship
key_terms.قَبِلَ: accepted and received favorably by Allah

ai.seo_question: Can one accepted prayer or good deed protect a person from punishment?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that the acceptance of even a single salat (prayer) or one good deed by Allah is a means of salvation from punishment. The hadith emphasizes the immense value of sincerity and divine acceptance rather than mere outward quantity of deeds.
